annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because the creator promotes BitConnect lending as a way to double an investment in about 30 days and describes scaling that investment toward a million dollars. He urges viewers to open an account, lend BitConnect tokens, and join his team, while saying he earns money when they succeed; the video presents a displayed earnings balance as support for this solicitation.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: S03 fits because the creator solicits participation in BitConnect lending and ties that investment to rapid, compounding returns, including doubling an investment in 30 days and a path toward a million dollars. This goes beyond mentioning a return: he recommends investing, reinvesting, and joining his team, and uses his displayed lending-profit and affiliate-bonus figures to promote participation.
